limitations.text: No character-specific glyph is available here to illustrate 這. The dictionary account reports that it is absent from oracle-bone and bronze inscriptions and Shuowen, and the queried glyph database returned no 這-specific record; therefore no verifiable historical image can be selected. The older verb sense ‘meet/receive’ and the later demonstrative ‘this/here’ are documented separately, with no established link between their histories.
